name: std::future<T>::wait
intro:
Blocks until the result becomes available. valid() == true after the call.

The behavior is undefined if valid() == false before the call to this function.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: The implementations are encouraged to detect the case when valid() == false before the call and throw a std::future_error with an error condition of std::future_errc::no_state.
